name: ui-catalog
description: Components a site publishes through a shadcn registry, with each one's item URL. Never cached.

verbs.name: registry
verbs.description: Every item in a site's shadcn registry index, in the index's order. Prints one item URL per line, or the catalog with --json.

url.description: Site URL, read at <site>/r/registry.json, or an index URL ending in .json.

base.description: Folder URL that holds the item files. Defaults to the index's own folder.

verbs.name: parse
verbs.description: Catalog from a registry index file already on disk.

path.description: A shadcn registry index JSON file.

base.description: Folder URL that holds the item files. Defaults to the index's homepage plus /r/.
